summary: Activated explicit T2S Relay connection for master plus three Workers using Keychain-backed Relay and local ADP tokens; restarted exact S-profile services.
T2S directory showed master/worker/worker-2/worker-3 online with role-correct idle projections; HTTP health/root and ADP session query passed for every Agent.
Exact worker-3 service bootout produced online=false and proxy 404 relay_agent_not_found; restartWorkerS restored online=true under a new PID.
Installed daemon SHA matched build e7366157a74c23dcc61aa5a3979817f51bcbb4a6e2368e1f503dd6e87d99de09; Relay 29+4, runtime 260, daemon 22, clippy, build, fmt, mainlines, and gates passed.

Two local Master daemons competed for one Relay identity; after the old process departed, stale cloud registry control truth rejected the current generation. Relay restart recovery isolated the defect to tunnel registry lifecycle.

Same-identity control replacement is generation-fenced, old data/error attachments are removed, and old pending exchanges fail through typed OpenFailure; Relay 29 unit plus 4 black-box tests and architecture gates passed.

Installed T2S ARM64 Relay SHA-512 46e3afff2dd8c8773007f91103eb06f497f9521e7a017375d54d7b3f14bc282884dd2a087c33a2ae8e80e0fb9dd464539bac519f3f9b9790883fbab7e68c9046 into exact container freehand-relay-live-20260802; health returned ok.

A second client with the exact Master account/token/Agent identity became current without Relay restart; directory and daemon health remained live and all four product Agents returned online idle truth.

codex -p asxs review --uncommitted found no discrete correctness, security, performance, or maintainability issues; reviewer socket-bind limitation is covered by prior unrestricted integration and deployed replay evidence.
